hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; aec() { python3 -c 'import os, runpy, sys; c = os.getcwd(); sys.path[:] = [p for p in sys.path if p and os.path.abspath(p) != c]; sys.argv[0] = "aec"; runpy.run_module("aec", run_name="__main__", alter_sys=True)' "$@"; }; aec code-impact --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- --exit-code || { echo 'Telosmith hook: the installed aec has no code-impact --exit-code; install the commit CI pins (tools/aec_upstream.json): pip install "git+https://github.com/eraevous/Telosmith.git@<commit>"' >&2; exit 1; }; aec edges . -o .aec/edges.jsonl 2>/dev/null; aec check .aec/records.jsonl --edges .aec/edges.jsonl >/dev/null || { aec check .aec/records.jsonl --edges .aec/edges.jsonl 1>&2; exit 2; }; aec snapshot . --rev HEAD -o .aec/hook-before.jsonl 2>/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(aec code-impact .aec/records.jsonl .aec/hook-before.jsonl .aec/edges.jsonl --exit-code 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" '(Telosmith: stale/needs_review lines are status changes; structural pointer lines are candidates for attention and change no status. Report-only: the edit already happened.)' >&2; exit 2; }
